crossRefs.note: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
Therefore speak to them, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols…
If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you…
If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you…
What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward…
yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word…
Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and…
They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and…
They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor…
choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.
For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

translations.web: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
translations.bsb: Be careful not to turn to iniquity, for this you have preferred to affliction.
translations.kjv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
translations.asv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
